notes.title: Update notes for October 28
notes.notes:
After a short break we returned with few improvements:

 Game size reduced. 
 Body rotation with joystick is improved.
 Translation improvements in all languages. 


In the near future you can wait more of the game updates with requested features.

notes.title: Update Notes For Aug 22
notes.notes:
Fixed issue with missing paper from the board after continue through save file (all missing papers are gonna be attached to the board).
 Fixed issue with displaying a wrong hint.
 Small improvements for locked elements.

notes.title: Update Notes for Aug 21
notes.notes:
Removed FPS lock on 80 FPS. The frame rate was set with smoothing from 60 to 144.
 Now background audio plays even if player outside of hearing radius.

notes.title: Update Notes For Aug 20
notes.notes:
Added some notes in apartment with information on how to use the hint system.
 Increased the range of hand angles to activate hints.
